aggregateForWithdrawal(address,address,u.details: Aggregate multiple L2-only UTXOs and create an Exit UTXO for withdrawal This allows users to withdraw any amount (up to their total balance) by: 1. Aggregating all their L2-only UTXOs 2. Creating an "Exit UTXO" for the withdrawal amount 3. Creating a "Change UTXO" for remaining balance (stays on L2) The Exit UTXO will be registered on L1 by the operator, enabling withdrawal.

returns.exitUtxoId: The UTXO ID that can be used for L1 withdrawal

createBlock().details: Create new block with pending UTXOs

createBlockChunked(uint256).details: Chunked block creation. Process up to `maxOps` pending UTXOs per call. Returns (blockNumber, isComplete). When isComplete=true, a new block is committed. Caller should keep calling until isComplete to drain pendingUtxos. This avoids out-of-gas when many UTXOs accumulate before a block commit.

transferUtxoBatch(bytes32[],address[],ui.details: Batch transfer for high-throughput scenarios (single-sender) All input UTXOs must be owned by msg.sender. No signature needed. Each sub-op has 1 input and 1-2 outputs (matched by outputCounts).

params.inputs: N input UTXO IDs (one per sub-op, all owned by msg.sender)
params.outputCounts: Number of outputs per sub-op (length = N, each 1 or 2)
